揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. Since the code for Qingzhou was changed from DO to QO—and both codes exist in the navigation database—flight crews must distinguish between them carefully to avoid entering DO out of habit.

揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: air or sea route ： For departures from DABER heading north: after passing DABER, ATC may instruct the aircraft to fly direct to TEBON or XLN, and then to QO to join the airway. for the flight back to ZGOW, ATC may instruct the aircraft to flyfrom QO to XLN or TEBON, and then to DABER to join the arrival procedure. For ZGOW-ZGKL flights:after takeoff and upon crossing airway X63, ATC may instruct the aircraft to fly direct to SHL, followed by VEROK. For ZSNJ (Nanjing) arrivals: ATC will instruct the aircraft to flyvia EMRID to airway V143 and then to OLRIS. After OLRIS, the aircraft will proceed to SNQ (Shiqiu) or receive radar vectors to join the appropriate approach procedure. The final waypoint listed on the clearance isGOSRO (via W135). Upon passing KAKIS (the entry point to the arrival corridor), control is handled by Hangzhou Approach; the handover to Nanjing Approach often occurs late, creating a risk of flying the wrong arrival or departure route. Itis recommended to confirm the arrival procedure in advance. 4. ZGHA-ZGOW Route: After passing BEMAG, follow ATC radar vectoring to aheading of 120°, then proceed direct to NUVGA to intercept Route H25 towards QU; for the approach, follow instructions to join the QU-9WA arrival route.

揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: For departures from Runway 04 towards DABER, the tower may temporarily instruct the aircraftto maintain the runway heading after takeoff. Due to terrain constraints, the aircraft must climb above 2,100 meters as quickly as possible; subsequently, the tower will instruct a left turn direct to DABER.

揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. Since the code for Qingzhou was changed from DO to QO—and both codes exist in the navigation database—flight crews must distinguish between them carefully to avoid entering DO out of habit.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: SASAN Point Merge procedure: inner arc (ESBAG direction) altitude ≥5400 m; outer arc (PIMOL/ZJ direction) altitude ≤5100 m; speed limit AT 260 kt.Aircraft on SS603-SASAN shall not deviate east of track without clearance; when airspace restrictions apply, descend to 3600 m–4800 m prior to 15 KM from SASAN.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport will implement the Taxiway A / K1 Junction Supplementary Pavement Renovation Project. During Phases 1 and 2 (planned 1 September 2026 – 31 October 2026), flights parked/serviced inthe East Area thatfail tovacate via Taxiway A2 in a timely manner will have to taxi back via Taxiways B3 and B2 along Taxiway B, crossing the east runway via H4; or via Taxiway B1 along H2 and Taxiway C, crossing the west runway via H4, then Taxiway B and the east runway to return.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Regarding the Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS/A-VDGS) at Hongqiao Airport bridges: as the aircraftapproaches the stop line,the distance readout decreases rapidly and may suddenly jump to "STOP." Crews should control the docking speed—within the last 10 m, control speed so that "SLOW" does not appear on the guidance display; within the last5 m, ensure the aircraft can be stopped at any time to avoid crossing the stop line.

zh.text_en: For departures from Runway 04 towards DABER, the tower may temporarily instruct the aircraftto maintain the runway heading after takeoff. Due to terrain constraints, the aircraft must climb above 2,100 meters as quickly as possible; subsequently, the tower will instruct a left turn direct to DABER.

zh.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. Since the code for Qingzhou was changed from DO to QO—and both codes exist in the navigation database—flight crews must distinguish between them carefully to avoid entering DO out of habit.

zh.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport employs the SASAN Point Merge arrival procedure. For arrivals via SASAN, crews should select the appropriate transition (ESBAG/ZJ/PIMOL) based on the flight plan and LID information. Upon firstcontact with approach control, crews should report the arrival/transition/approach/runway information per the LID information.

zh.source_text_en: SASAN Point Merge procedure: inner arc (ESBAG direction) altitude ≥5400 m; outer arc (PIMOL/ZJ direction) altitude ≤5100 m; speed limit AT 260 kt.Aircraft on SS603-SASAN shall not deviate east of track without clearance; when airspace restrictions apply, descend to 3600 m–4800 m prior to 15 KM from SASAN.

zh.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport will implement the Taxiway A / K1 Junction Supplementary Pavement Renovation Project. During Phases 1 and 2 (planned 1 September 2026 – 31 October 2026), flights parked/serviced inthe East Area thatfail tovacate via Taxiway A2 in a timely manner will have to taxi back via Taxiways B3 and B2 along Taxiway B, crossing the east runway via H4; or via Taxiway B1 along H2 and Taxiway C, crossing the west runway via H4, then Taxiway B and the east runway to return.

zh.source_text_en: Regarding the Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS/A-VDGS) at Hongqiao Airport bridges: as the aircraftapproaches the stop line,the distance readout decreases rapidly and may suddenly jump to "STOP." Crews should control the docking speed—within the last 10 m, control speed so that "SLOW" does not appear on the guidance display; within the last5 m, ensure the aircraft can be stopped at any time to avoid crossing the stop line.

zh.source_text_en: Phase 1 (planned 1–30 September), construction in Areas A and B, operational impacts: a. Taxiways A1, K1, and T1 closed; Taxiway H1 between RWY 18L/36R and Taxiway A closed; Taxiway A between TaxiwayA2 and Taxiway H1 closed; Taxiways L01 and L08 north of Stand 315 closed. b. Stands 310, 311, 312, 313, 314 closed. c. Stand TP03 and De-icing Pad No. 8 withdrawn from service. d. Departures from Stand 315 are only permitted with nose-north pushback along the designated pushback line onto L01, then nose-west along L10 to holding point AP02 forengine start.

zh.source_text_en: Phase 3 (planned 1–30 November), construction in Area B, operational impacts: a. Taxiway K1 closed; Taxiway L01 north of Stand 315 closed. b. Stands 313, 314 closed. c. Stand TP03 and De-icing Pad No. 8 withdrawn from service. d. Departures from Stand 315 are only permitted with nose-north pushback along the designated pushback line onto L01, then nose-west along L10 to holding point AP02 for engine start. e. A temporary Taxiway Category C taxi guideline will be established (relocating the original Taxiway L01 north of Stand 315 eastward by 20 m), available exclusively to aircraft with wingspan less than 36 m, with temporary edge lights installed.

en.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. en.source_text_en: air or sea route ： For departures from DABER heading north: after passing DABER, ATC may instruct the aircraft to fly direct to TEBON or XLN, and then to QO to join the airway. for the flight back to ZGOW, ATC may instruct the aircraft to flyfrom QO to XLN or TEBON, and then to DABER to join the arrival procedure. For ZGOW-ZGKL flights:after takeoff and upon crossing airway X63, ATC may instruct the aircraft to fly direct to SHL, followed by VEROK. For ZSNJ (Nanjing) arrivals: ATC will instruct the aircraft to flyvia EMRID to airway V143 and then to OLRIS. After OLRIS, the aircraft will proceed to SNQ (Shiqiu) or receive radar vectors to join the appropriate approach procedure. The final waypoint listed on the clearance isGOSRO (via W135). Upon passing KAKIS (the entry point to the arrival corridor), control is handled by Hangzhou Approach; the handover to Nanjing Approach often occurs late, creating a risk of flying the wrong arrival or departure route. Itis recommended to confirm the arrival procedure in advance. 4. ZGHA-ZGOW Route: After passing BEMAG, follow ATC radar vectoring to aheading of 120°, then proceed direct to NUVGA to intercept Route H25 towards QU; for the approach, follow instructions to join the QU-9WA arrival route.

揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. Since the code for Qingzhou was changed from DO to QO—and both codes exist in the navigation database—flight crews must distinguish between them carefully to avoid entering DO out of habit.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: SASAN Point Merge procedure: inner arc (ESBAG direction) altitude ≥5400 m; outer arc (PIMOL/ZJ direction) altitude ≤5100 m; speed limit AT 260 kt.Aircraft on SS603-SASAN shall not deviate east of track without clearance; when airspace restrictions apply, descend to 3600 m–4800 m prior to 15 KM from SASAN.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport will implement the Taxiway A / K1 Junction Supplementary Pavement Renovation Project. During Phases 1 and 2 (planned 1 September 2026 – 31 October 2026), flights parked/serviced inthe East Area thatfail tovacate via Taxiway A2 in a timely manner will have to taxi back via Taxiways B3 and B2 along Taxiway B, crossing the east runway via H4; or via Taxiway B1 along H2 and Taxiway C, crossing the west runway via H4, then Taxiway B and the east runway to return.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Regarding the Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS/A-VDGS) at Hongqiao Airport bridges: as the aircraftapproaches the stop line,the distance readout decreases rapidly and may suddenly jump to "STOP." Crews should control the docking speed—within the last 10 m, control speed so that "SLOW" does not appear on the guidance display; within the last5 m, ensure the aircraft can be stopped at any time to avoid crossing the stop line.
